name: mcp-server
description: MCP server that runs the domain of pentomino-games. Local tooling: it is not in the bundle and not in the deploy. Node >=22.18 runs the .ts files with native type stripping, with no build: that is why this file sets that floor in `engines`. `typescript` is a devDependency, and `tsc` in `typecheck` is not its only user: `src/symbols.ts` imports it at runtime, so `start` needs the dev dependencies installed.
